b2-alkotmanytortenet-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Unwritten Constitution
b2-alkotmanytortenet-01.scenario: In the visitor centre of the Országház, a guide asks you what held Hungarian public law together before 1848, when there was no single written constitution.
b2-alkotmanytortenet-01.prompt: Tell the guide what the historical constitution was made of and what the Doctrine of the Holy Crown said about the state.
cues: Say what the historical constitution consisted of
Say what the Doctrine of the Holy Crown said about the state
b2-alkotmanytortenet-01.target: A történeti alkotmány szokásjogból és sarkalatos törvényekből állt. A közjogi hagyomány értelmében a Szent Korona testesítette meg az államot.
b2-alkotmanytortenet-01.english: The historical constitution consisted of customary law and cardinal laws. Under the public law tradition, the Holy Crown embodied the state.
b2-alkotmanytortenet-01.canDo: I can explain the concept and main elements of Hungary's historical (unwritten) constitution.

b2-alkotmanytortenet-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The April Laws
b2-alkotmanytortenet-02.scenario: At a history evening in the Országház, a student asks you what the April Laws of 1848 changed and to whom the first responsible government had to answer.
b2-alkotmanytortenet-02.prompt: Tell the student to whom the Batthyány government was responsible and what happened to the nobles' tax exemption.
cues: Say to whom the government was responsible
Say what happened to the nobles' tax exemption
b2-alkotmanytortenet-02.target: A Batthyány-kormány a népképviseleti parlamentnek tartozott felelősséggel. A közteherviselés elvével összhangban a nemesség adómentessége megszűnt.
b2-alkotmanytortenet-02.english: The Batthyány government was responsible to the representative parliament. In accordance with the principle of universal taxation, the nobles' tax exemption ended.
b2-alkotmanytortenet-02.canDo: I can describe the constitutional shift brought about by the 1848 April Laws.

b2-alkotmanytortenet-03.title: Communicative Challenge: How 1989 Happened
b2-alkotmanytortenet-03.scenario: At a debate evening on 23 October, a young visitor asks you how the regime change of 1989 could happen without violence.
b2-alkotmanytortenet-03.prompt: Tell the visitor what the parties agreed at the National Roundtable and what they were bound to observe.
cues: Say what the parties agreed at the National Roundtable
Say what the parties were bound to observe
b2-alkotmanytortenet-03.target: A felek a Nemzeti Kerekasztalnál megegyeztek a jogfolytonosságban, és kötelesek voltak betartani a hatályos törvényeket.
b2-alkotmanytortenet-03.english: At the National Roundtable the parties agreed on legal continuity, and they were bound to observe the laws in force.
b2-alkotmanytortenet-03.canDo: I can analyze the legal mechanics of Hungary's 1989 peaceful transition to democracy.

b2-alkotmanytortenet-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Court and the Death Penalty
b2-alkotmanytortenet-04.scenario: In the Donáti utca, a law student asks you what the Constitutional Court decided in 1990 and what happens to a law the Court finds unconstitutional.
b2-alkotmanytortenet-04.prompt: Tell the student what the Court declared in autumn 1990 and what must happen to an unconstitutional law.
cues: Say what the Court declared in autumn 1990
Say what must happen to an unconstitutional law
b2-alkotmanytortenet-04.target: Az Alkotmánybíróság 1990 őszén alkotmányellenesnek nyilvánította a halálbüntetést. Az alkotmányellenes jogszabály megsemmisítendő.
b2-alkotmanytortenet-04.english: In autumn 1990 the Constitutional Court declared the death penalty unconstitutional. An unconstitutional statute is to be annulled.
b2-alkotmanytortenet-04.canDo: I can discuss the jurisdiction, powers, and historical role of the Hungarian Constitutional Court.

b2-alkotmanytortenet-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Fundamental Law
b2-alkotmanytortenet-05.scenario: At a university seminar, a visitor asks you when the Fundamental Law came into force and what took the place of the actio popularis.
b2-alkotmanytortenet-05.prompt: Tell the visitor when the Alaptörvény entered into force and what took the place of the actio popularis.
cues: Say when the Fundamental Law entered into force
Say what took the place of the actio popularis
b2-alkotmanytortenet-05.target: Az Alaptörvény 2012. január 1-jén lépett hatályba. Az actio popularis helyére az alkotmányjogi panasz lépett.
b2-alkotmanytortenet-05.english: The Fundamental Law entered into force on 1 January 2012. The constitutional complaint took the place of the actio popularis.
b2-alkotmanytortenet-05.canDo: I can describe the adoption, structure, and distinctive preambles of the 2011 Fundamental Law (Alaptörvény).

b2-alkotmanytortenet-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: From Custom to the Alaptörvény
b2-alkotmanytortenet-consolidation.scenario: At the end of a history course in the Országház, the lecturer asks you to sum up in two sentences how Hungarian public law developed from the historical constitution to the Alaptörvény.
b2-alkotmanytortenet-consolidation.prompt: Sum up what the historical constitution consisted of, what principle the parties followed in 1989, and when the Alaptörvény entered into force.
cues: Say what the historical constitution consisted of and what principle was followed in 1989
Say when the Fundamental Law entered into force
b2-alkotmanytortenet-consolidation.target: A történeti alkotmány szokásjogból és sarkalatos törvényekből állt, 1989-ben pedig a felek a jogfolytonosság elvét követték. Az Alaptörvény 2012. január 1-jén lépett hatályba.
b2-alkotmanytortenet-consolidation.english: The historical constitution consisted of customary law and cardinal laws, and in 1989 the parties followed the principle of legal continuity. The Fundamental Law entered into force on 1 January 2012.
b2-alkotmanytortenet-consolidation.canDo: I can review and synthesize the evolution of Hungarian public law from customary constitution to the Alaptörvény.
